moe_resident.note: Idea H5: the grouped MoE path without the E+1 offsets download + mid-forward sync, the per-call GEMM workspace and the scratch zero fills. One launch per product over all experts (grid.z = expert, row extent = capacity bound T), blocks read poff on the device and exit past their expert's count; cells are moe_contract_cell term for term (same bits as the grouped GEMM). Needs MOE_GROUPED_GEMM on (the default).
